provenance.inputs_summary: stored Aspen baseline / fuel-cell scenario activities; Ahmad 2025 turbine efficiencies and plant economics; economics.yaml prices

model_versions.aspen_inputs: stored results/simulations/baseline.json and scn_fuel_cell_grade.json (Aspen Plus V15)
model_versions.economics: Phase 2 reference scenario: amcrax.economics.singapore.evaluate (H2) and amcrax.economics.reference.reference_capex (cracker in power pathways); all cost inputs from data/reference_scenario.yaml
model_versions.purification: results/research/purification/purification_study.json (workstream P) for the purified-H2 rows; stored scn_fuel_cell_grade kept as the Aspen-scenario variant

halim_claim_check.halim_statement: direct NH3 combustion about 40 % cheaper than cracking-based power (task brief; Halim abstract confirms only 'preferable because of high capital and operating costs of cracking')

crossover_prices.note: None = the pathways do not cross between 1 and 5000 USD/t; below the crossover price the capital-heavy pathway is dearer, above it the efficiency gain pays.

halim_claim_check.verdict_note: Computed gap depends strongly on whether the cracker is exhaust-heated (literature 54 % efficiency) or fired, and on purification; see results table. Halim's inputs were not accessed.

hydrogen_summary.note: Increment is the stored-scenario difference (PSA recovery 0.85 -> 0.80, N2 slip 1e-3 -> 5e-4); it excludes NH3 polishing and other ISO 14687 contaminants, so it is a lower bound.

limitations: Efficiencies of intermediate blends are a linear interpolation of Ahmad's two end points (assumption).

Fired and purified variants apply the direct-NH3 turbine efficiency to H2-rich fuel (assumption); the threshold at which each conclusion reverses is in turbine_threshold.json (scripts/research/enduse_threshold.py). Exhaust-heated variants use Ahmad's system efficiency instead (implied 47.8 % on cracked-gas LHV).
Plant capital outside the cracker is Ahmad's Case 2a scaled with power^0.67; no NOx abatement cost.
Fuel-cell candidate cost excludes NH3 polishing and other ISO 14687 contaminant control.
Halim et al. (2025) full text was not accessible; only the abstract and bibliographic data were checked.
nox_note: NO and N2O are only available for direct NH3 (Ahmad Chemkin, simulated); other fuels are 'not quantified'. NOx is a local pollutant and is never added to CO2e.
source_note: results/research/enduse/enduse_results.json; subset of top-level keys, values as stored
